en: The postcard features three black-and-white photographic images. The top-left image shows 'Gasthof Hohenzollern', a guesthouse nestled among trees and greenery. The top-right photo shows a terrace with several tables and chairs, overlooking a scenic landscape of hills and fields. The bottom photo offers a panoramic view from the terrace of the Gasthof Hohenzollern, with a church steeple and a town in the valley below, surrounded by hills and vineyards. The overall feel is pastoral and idyllic, characteristic of the German countryside.
